notes: Description des visuels pour shorts/grok.mjs. Les références sont les fichiers de shorts/references/ (sans extension).

costumes.deguisement: the burglar keeps his black balaclava and black and white striped sweater, but wears a bright orange high-visibility work vest over it, a fake badge clipped on the vest, and carries a clipboard

shots.image: the burglar in his technician disguise standing proudly in front of a warehouse at night, mischievous buck-toothed grin, thumbs up
shots.animate: the burglar adjusts his orange vest proudly and gives a sly wink

shots.image: the disguised burglar pressing the buzzer of a small glass guard booth at night, trying to look professional, streetlight above
shots.animate: he presses the buzzer twice and straightens up with a fake serious face

shots.image: close-up of the disguised burglar holding up his clipboard with a big fake friendly smile, as if talking to someone through a window, warm light from the booth on his face
shots.animate: he talks enthusiastically, tapping his clipboard and pointing at his fake badge

shots.image: the chubby mustached security guard with neon yellow vest inside his booth, looking at the disguised burglar through the glass, nodding convinced, his hand on the door handle opening the door
shots.animate: the guard nods slowly, convinced, and opens the door with a welcoming gesture

shots.image: the disguised burglar in a dim technical room in front of a wall-mounted alarm control panel with glowing red lights, his gloved finger about to press one big button, sneaky grin
shots.animate: his finger presses the big button, all the panel lights switch from red to off one by one

shots.image: the white dome security camera mounted in a dim corridor, its red lens eye wide open in disbelief, staring down at the scene, tiny sweat drop on the dome
shots.animate: the camera's eye blinks twice in disbelief and slowly shakes as if saying no

shots.image: the burglar in his usual outfit (black balaclava, striped sweater, no vest) tiptoeing inside a dark warehouse at night with a flashlight and a money bag, the alarm panel on the wall completely dark
shots.animate: he tiptoes with exaggerated sneaky cartoon steps, flashlight beam sweeping

shots.image: the fat orange tabby cat sitting on a dark parked car hood at night, narrowed suspicious eyes, one eyebrow raised, judging someone off-screen
shots.animate: the cat narrows its eyes, flicks its tail and slowly shakes its head

shots.image: early morning, the female security technician arriving at the warehouse gate holding her rugged tablet, surprised puzzled expression, sunrise sky
shots.animate: she stops, raises an eyebrow and looks around puzzled, ponytail moving in the wind

shots.image: the technician showing her tablet to the embarrassed chubby security guard, the tablet displays a calendar with one highlighted appointment, the guard scratching his head
shots.animate: she taps the highlighted appointment on her tablet, the guard scratches his head embarrassed

shots.image: the technician holding a phone to her ear and pointing at an official company card pinned on the booth wall, the guard listening and nodding seriously, morning light
shots.animate: she talks on the phone while pointing at the card, the guard nods seriously

shots.image: the chubby mustached security guard at his booth window very seriously inspecting the ID card of a confused mail carrier holding letters, the fat orange cat sitting on the counter looking smug, daytime
shots.animate: the guard squints at the ID card with exaggerated suspicion, the cat slowly blinks smugly
